title: Attacker url observed in the wild: http://vagos.cc/Sakura.sh (OffSeq Mirage)
description: The URL http://vagos.cc/Sakura.sh was observed in attacker activity by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-11. It is associated with the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating it is used for downloading attacker tools or payloads. The attacker infrastructure was identified in the Netherlands. This URL has been seen in attacker payloads such as tool downloads, callbacks, or exploitation targets. Organizations are advised to block and monitor this URL and search their proxy, web, or WAF logs for any requests to it.
